verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that npm's own CLI can add a package (`npm install blerg` installs the latest version). Nothing in the pack documents removing or upgrading dependencies, or confirms that these commands safely rewrite package.json and the lockfile. Missing for 10: documented remove (uninstall) command, documented upgrade (update) command, explicit manifest and lockfile rewrite behavior, any safety guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add, remove, and upgrade dependencies through CLI commands that safely rewrite the manifest and lockfile, so an agent never hand-edits them

citations.quote: You can also run `npm install blerg` to install the latest version of "blerg".
The very first thing you will most likely want to run in any node program is `npm install` to install its dependencies.
